of.needed: whether the ingress-nginx strict-validate-path-type configuration option is enabled
whether any ACME issuer in the environment uses the HTTP01 ingress-based challenge solver

consequence.statement: The Ingress cert-manager creates to present an ACME HTTP01 challenge is denied by the ingress-nginx admission webhook `validate.nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io` ("ingress contains invalid…", logged in the cert-manager controller as "Error presenting challenge"), so ACME HTTP01 challenges cannot be solved when ingress-nginx >= 1.8.0 runs with `strict-validate-path-type` enabled (the default from ingress-nginx >= 1.12.0).

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 sets the `PathType` of the Ingress routes it creates for ACME HTTP01 challenges to `Exact`, which is incompatible with ingress-nginx configurations where the `strict-validate-path-type` option rejects paths containing a dot, so the `/.well-known/acme-challenge/<TOKEN>` challenge Ingress is denied by the `validate.nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io` admission webhook.
